Here is an exhaustive map of **production server-side** memo visibility / read enforcement in `/bench/repo`, excluding tests and client-side UI filtering.

---

## Summary

There are **10 distinct named enforcement functions** plus **6 query-level filter sites** and **1 alternate read path (share tokens)**. Transport-level auth (`Authorizer.CheckAccess`, `acl_config.go`) is **not** memo visibility enforcement—it only decides whether anonymous callers may reach certain RPCs; memo rules are applied inside services.

Visibility model used everywhere:
- **PUBLIC** — readable without auth (subject to instance privacy / share-token rules on files)
- **PROTECTED** — any authenticated user
- **PRIVATE** — creator only (most checks also grant admins via `isSuperUser`)
- **Archived** — creator only (`checkMemoReadAccess` only)

---

## 1. Named enforcement functions

### `checkMemoReadAccess` — primary memo read gate
**`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`**

```39:68:server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
func (s *APIV1Service) checkMemoReadAccess(ctx context.Context, memo *store.Memo) error {
	// ... archived → creator only ...
	if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
		// ... unauthenticated → denied ...
		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
			return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
		}
	}
	return nil
}
```

**Call sites (read enforcement):**
| Line | RPC / use |
|------|-----------|
| `memo_service.go:356`, `:367` | `GetMemo` (+ parent memo for comments) |
| `memo_service_comments.go:148` | `ListMemoComments` (parent memo gate) |

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Yes** — canonical per-memo read check for single-memo fetches. Note: no admin bypass here (unlike inline checks elsewhere).

---

### `checkAttachmentAccess` — API attachment metadata read
**`server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422`**

Unlinked attachments → creator/admin only. Linked attachments follow parent memo visibility (PUBLIC open; PROTECTED/PRIVATE require auth + creator for private).

**Call site:** `attachment_service.go:256` (`GetAttachment`)

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Yes** — blocks attachment metadata when linked memo is not readable.

---

### `checkAttachmentPermission` — HTTP binary file serving
**`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650`**

Same memo-visibility logic as above, plus:
- **`share_token` query param** bypass for share-page attachments (`:684–688`)
- PUBLIC attachments on **private instances** still require auth unless share token (`:674–678`)

**Call site:** `fileserver.go:149` (`serveAttachmentFile`)

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Yes** — enforces actual file bytes, not just metadata. This is the enforcement path for `/file/attachments/...` URLs (including RSS enclosures).

---

### `SSEClient.canReceive` — realtime event filtering
**`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`**

```134:143:server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go
func (c *SSEClient) canReceive(event *SSEEvent) bool {
	switch event.Visibility {
	case store.Private:
		return c.userID == event.CreatorID || c.role == store.RoleAdmin
	case store.Public, store.Protected, "":
		return true
	// ...
}
```

**Call site:** `sse_hub.go:123` (`SSEHub.Broadcast`)

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Partial** — prevents SSE subscribers from learning about private memo *events* (create/update/delete/comment/reaction). Does **not** gate memo content itself; SSE connection already requires auth (`sse_handler.go:38–43`).

---

### `canViewerAccessMemo` (email dispatcher)
**`server/notification/email.go:306`**

**Call sites:** `:155`, `:187` (email body construction for comment/mention notifications)

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Yes, for outbound email** — suppresses memo URLs/snippets when the recipient could not view the memo. Not an API read gate.

---

### `canViewerAccessMemo` (in-app notifications API)
**`server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302`**

Duplicate logic (uses `isSuperUser` instead of `RoleAdmin`). **Call sites:** `:337`, `:342`, `:370`, `:385`.

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Yes, for notification payloads** — hides memo snippets/names in `ListNotifications` responses.

---

### `canUserAccessMentionContext`
**`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56`**

Gates whether mention inbox notifications are created/sent.

**Truly enforces read/view?** **No (direct read)** — side-effect filter only; prevents notifying users who cannot see the mentioned memo context.

---

### `getActiveMemoShare` / `GetMemoByShare` — share-link read path
**`server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:199`** (token validation)  
**`memo_share_service.go:151`** (`GetMemoByShare` — returns full memo without `checkMemoReadAccess`)

Public RPC per `acl_config.go:40`; works even on private instances (`acl_config.go:71`).

**Truly enforces read/view?** **Yes** — alternate authorized read path via opaque, non-expired share token. Intentionally bypasses normal visibility rules.
